ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is triangle RST, with R and T on the horizontal line of the base, and S in the upper right. Point X is on side RS, point Y is on the base RT, and point Z is on side ST. Segment XY goes diagonally upward from Y to X, and segment XZ goes horizontally right from X to Z. In the figure, 124° is marked at X; it is the angle formed by ray XY (pointing from X to Y) and ray XZ (pointing from X to Z). The problem states that XY and XZ are midlines of triangle RST. Reasoning: Because XZ is a midline of triangle RST, XZ ∥ RT. Also because R, Y, and T are collinear, ray YR has the same straight-line direction as the base RT, and is parallel to ray ZX. The angle being asked for, ∠RYX, is the angle formed by YR and YX. The marked 124° is the angle formed by XY and XZ; after reversing the directions of these two rays respectively, the corresponding YX and YR are obtained, and the angle measure does not change. Therefore m∠RYX = 124°.

raw_record.question_text: $\overline{XY}$ and $\overline{XZ}$ are midsegments of $\triangle RST$. Find $m\angle RYX$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: in triangle RST, points X, Y, and Z lie on sides RS, RT, and ST respectively; segment XZ is drawn horizontally parallel to base RT, and the marked 124° angle is at X between rays XY and XZ. From the text, use that XY and XZ are midsegments of triangle RST, so in particular XZ is parallel to RT. Since R, Y, and T are collinear on the base, ray YR is parallel to ray ZX but points in the corresponding leftward direction. Therefore the angle formed by YX with YR equals the marked corresponding angle formed by XY with XZ, giving m∠RYX = 124°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是三角形 RST，R 和 T 在底边水平线上，S 在右上方。点 X 在边 RS 上，点 Y 在底边 RT 上，点 Z 在边 ST 上。线段 XY 从 Y 斜向上到 X，线段 XZ 从 X 水平向右到 Z。图中在 X 处标出 124°，它是由射线 XY（从 X 指向 Y）和射线 XZ（从 X 指向 Z）形成的角。题目给出 XY 和 XZ 是三角形 RST 的中位线。

推理：因为 XZ 是三角形 RST 的中位线，所以 XZ ∥ RT。又因为 R、Y、T 共线，所以射线 YR 与底边 RT 同一直线方向，且与射线 ZX 平行。所求角 ∠RYX 是由 YR 和 YX 形成的角。标出的 124° 是由 XY 和 XZ 形成的角；将这两个射线方向分别反向后，对应得到 YX 和 YR，角度大小不变。因此 m∠RYX = 124°。
